metadata.title: Holomorphic sectional curvature and the Calabi operator on Kähler C-spaces
metadata.abstract: We study holomorphic sectional curvature and the Calabi curvature operator on compact Kähler manifolds. First we show that every homogeneous Kähler metric on a generalized flag manifold has positive holomorphic sectional curvature. For the standard homogeneous Kähler-Einstein metric with Einstein constant 2, it is shown that the spectrum of the Calabi operator lies in $(-2,2]$. We determine its sharp upper bound in terms of the anticanonical degrees and characterize the 2-eigenspace. The spectral bounds imply nonnegative cross quadratic bisectional curvature and positive dual cross quadratic bisectional curvature, proving conjectures of Ni and Zheng. We also show that these conditions do not characterize homogeneity: we construct a nonhomogeneous Kähler-Einstein 13-fold whose Calabi spectrum lies strictly inside $(-2,2)$ after the same normalization, as well as nonhomogeneous examples in dimensions 4 and 5. The proofs involve an integral identity for holomorphic sectional curvature, projective embeddings, root-space estimates, and explicit metrics on projective bundles.

analysis.progressType: 齐性Kähler曲率与Calabi算子的谱界
analysis.workSummary: 定理1.1对固定G不变复结构的正维紧广义旗流形，任意G不变Kähler度量均有正全纯截面曲率。定理1.2针对标准齐性KE度量、Ric=2g，Calabi算子C作用于Sym²T¹⁰且Spec(C)⊂(−2,2]；精确λ_max=4/k_*，其中k_*为涂色简单根对应Schubert曲线的最小反典范次数。2特征空间由k_α=2的e_α⊗e_α张成。
techniques: 正分级阻尼下全纯截面曲率的平方范数积分
基本表示给等距射影乘积嵌入及Gauss上界
按切根之和分块的根计数和矩阵下界
射影丛的显式势、KE方程及端点光滑延拓
Ricci特征值与Calabi收缩联合估计CQB
analysis.breakthrough: 谱界给CQB≥0及对偶dCQB>0；k_*>2等价于不存在纤维为P¹的齐性投影，并给严格CQB。13维非齐性射影丛有Ric=g的显式KE度量，谱精确界[−1/2,11/12]，缩放至Ric=2g后为[−1,11/6]。4维及5维反例分别给CQB≥0、dCQB≥(1/8)|A|²，以及两者≥(1/4)|A|²。
analysis.limitations: 4、5维例子的度量明确非Einstein，需联合Ricci特征值而非仅凭C谱判断曲率形式。第5页补记Jian–Zhang同时期工作与定理1.2经典类型部分重叠。反例切丛有负次数商线丛，不满足nef切丛条件。仅审主定理、规范和证明路线，未独立复核所有例外根系矩阵、反例完整曲率计算及所引标准结构结果。
